claims.claim_text: Abouzaid--Blumberg is an immediate seed for the target because the target explicitly says their work arranges framed flow categories into a stable infinity-category modeling spectra, and the target builds a μ-structured analogue of that setup.
claims.quotation_or_excerpt: More recently, Abouzaid--Blumberg show that framed flow categories can be arranged into a stable $\infty$-category, and show that this is a model for the $\infty$-category of spectra~\cite[Proposition 1.10]{AB}. ... The main construction of the paper is a family of Abouzaid--Blumberg style $\infty$-categories $\Flow^{\mu}$ of $\mu$-structured flow categories.
claims.inclusion_reason: The target names AB as the central prior model for stable infinity-categories of flow categories and explicitly presents its own main construction as an AB-style generalization.

claims.claim_text: Douglas is a supporting seed because the target explicitly says Douglas provided a framework for twisted stable homotopy theory needed for the non-framed setting.
claims.quotation_or_excerpt: That some version of twisted stable homotopy theory is needed to deal with non-framed Floer homotopy theory was perhaps first pointed out by Furuta ... A framework for twisted stable homotopy theory was provided by Douglas in his PhD thesis~\cite{Dou}.
claims.inclusion_reason: The target directly credits Douglas with supplying framework-level background for the twisted stable homotopy side of the paper's main comparison.

claims.claim_text: Gepner--Haugseng is a technique ancestor because the target says it works in the context of enriched infinity-categories as defined there to handle coherence in μ-structures.
claims.quotation_or_excerpt: To deal with the coherence involved when defining a $\mu$-structure on a flow category, we will work in the context of enriched $\infty$-categories as defined by \cite{GH}.
claims.inclusion_reason: The target names GH as the technical framework for handling enriched infinity-categorical coherence.

claims.claim_text: Gepner--Haugseng--Nikolaus is a technique ancestor because the target uses their work to frame oplax limits and colimits in the twisted presheaf construction.
claims.quotation_or_excerpt: (Op)Lax limits were first introduced in the $\infty$-categorical setting in~\cite{GHN}.
claims.inclusion_reason: The target explicitly invokes GHN for the oplax limit technology used in the twisted presheaf side of the theorem.

claims.claim_text: Christ--Dyckerhoff--Walde is a technique ancestor because the target cites lax additivity to identify the twisted presheaf construction with an oplax colimit or limit presentation.
claims.quotation_or_excerpt: The $\infty$-category $\TwShv^{\mu}$ can be defined as a certain oplax limit in $\PrLSt$, which by lax additivity \cite{CDW} is also an oplax colimit.
claims.inclusion_reason: The target explicitly ties CDW to the lax-additivity step that supports the TwShv side of the main theorem.

claims.claim_text: Hedenlund--Moulinos is a technique ancestor because the target says twisted presheaves generalize twisted spectra and cites that work for the infinity-categorical framework of twisted spectra.
claims.quotation_or_excerpt: Twisted presheaves are a generalization of twisted spectra as introduced in Douglas' PhD thesis~\cite{Dou}, and later put into the $\infty$-categorical framework by the first author together with Moulinos~\cite{HM}.
claims.inclusion_reason: The target explicitly uses HM as part of the technical path from twisted spectra to twisted presheaves.

claims.claim_text: Oldervoll is a technique ancestor because the target explicitly uses quasi-unital inner Kan spaces from that work to present the infinity-category underlying the flow construction.
claims.quotation_or_excerpt: The theory of such objects was developed in \cite{oldervoll2026quasi}, where it is shown that $X$ represents an $\infty$-category $\cT(X)$.
claims.inclusion_reason: The target directly names Oldervoll's quasi-unital inner Kan spaces as part of the machinery used to pass from semi-simplicial spaces to infinity-categories.

claims.claim_text: A central inherited pressure point is extending stable-homotopy-style flow-category technology from framed settings to non-framed settings with tangential, local-system, and filtration data that can interact.
claims.quotation_or_excerpt: Far from all flow categories associated with Floer data are frameable ... Such data is then expected to represent a module over the Thom spectrum~$MG$ ... We have seen that various flavors of Floer homotopy types are expected to define objects in the stable $\infty$-categories $\Mod_{MG}$, $\Sp^{X}$, and $\Fun(A^{\op},\Sp)$ respectively. These admit a common generalization: they are all $\infty$-categories of twisted presheaves.
